title: Account and Access Lifecycle
summary: Trace account creation, review, modification, and disablement concepts.
objectives: Identify lifecycle states and stale-access risks.

vocab.def: Set up an account or access for an approved purpose.
An account that remains active without a current need.
A structured check that permissions still match responsibilities.

sections.heading: Lifecycle
sections.body: Accounts may be created, provisioned, modified, reviewed, disabled, and archived according to authorized procedures. Former-worker accounts and excess roles require attention.

sections.heading: Do not improvise
sections.body: Students inspect synthetic rosters and recommend review. They do not change real accounts, credentials, or permissions.

practice.prompt: A former worker remains active in a synthetic roster. What should be recorded?
practice.answer: Record the account state and escalate for an authorized lifecycle review.

quiz.question: What is an access review for?

reflectionPrompt: What source record would support an account-status decision?
